sources.name: Lakehead University - International Student Services
sources.notes: The single best-fit source for this city (International Centre, ISS events/workshops, Community Connections Fair). Page IS reachable (200 OK, confirmed 2026-08-26) and server-rendered - it runs Drupal Views: <div class="view view-events-upcoming view-id-events_upcoming view-display-id-events_grid_photo events-grid events-grid-photo"> containing repeated <div class="event-item event-item-photo"> blocks, paginated via ?page=0,1,0,2 etc on the same /iss URL (not a separate monthly-grid route like Queen's queensu_drupal kind, so that parser does not apply as-is). A dedicated 'lakehead_drupal' parser reading these event-item blocks would be a clean, high-value addition - flagging for central addition rather than forking a one-off scraper here.

sources.name: Confederation College - International
sources.notes: 403 Forbidden on automated fetch (confirmed 2026-08-26, likely a WAF/bot-block) - could not inspect the page at all. Re-probe with a browser-rendering tool rather than curl/WebFetch.

sources.name: Thunder Bay Public Library
sources.notes: Communico/libnet feed, same pattern as Hamilton/Kingston (host varies per library, this one uses the libnet.info domain directly rather than a custom calendar.<lib>.ca subdomain). Confirmed live 2026-08-26: GET https://tbpl.libnet.info/eeventcaldata?event_type=0&req={"private":false,"date":"YYYY-MM-DD","days":N} returns a bare JSON array, 514 events in a 90-day window - the strongest source found for this city by far.

sources.name: Thunder Bay Multicultural Association (TBMA)
sources.notes: 17 N. Court St - the anchor settlement agency since 1972 (orientation, SIN/OHIP/driver's license help, Host mentoring program, English Conversation Circles, and the LINC School free English classes - contact leemaf@thunderbay.org / maggiel@thunderbay.org, 807-345-0551). No dated-events feed found - hand-enter workshops/info sessions as announced.

sources.name: City of Thunder Bay Events Calendar
sources.notes: Same eSolutionsGroup/GovStack platform as Brantford (X-Frame-Options here explicitly names icrt-cotb.esolutionsgroup.ca). Unlocked 2026-09-09 by the new generic `govstack_calendar` parser - see [[reference-hamilton-event-sources]]-style notes on brantford.json's brantford-library entry for how it works.

sources.name: Thunder Bay Tourism Events Calendar
sources.notes: Same eSolutionsGroup platform as the City calendar above - unlocked 2026-09-09, same parser. The human-facing page is at /tourism, but that path 404s the underlying /default/Month API - confirmed the bare domain root is the correct base for the parser (checked explicitly since this tenant differs from the others).

sources.name: Thunder Bay Festivals (hand-entered)
sources.notes: Ribfest (Thunder City Speedway, confirmed Aug 27-30 2026) and Arts & Culture Under the Lights (Sept 18 2026) hand-entered with confirmed dates. Festival of India (Jul 18) and Festa Italiana (Aug 2) already passed the 3-month build window at onboarding time - re-add for a build starting earlier in summer.

sources.name: Lakehead University Christian Fellowship (LUCF)
sources.notes: On-campus InterVarsity-affiliated Christian group at Lakehead - the clearest campus-based spiritual fit found for Thunder Bay (per the onboarding reference's 'campus chaplaincies, student Christian groups' archetype). Only reachable via the LUSU club directory and Facebook, no standalone site with a schedule/feed - registered manual with an empty list. Lakehead's own Chaplaincy office (lakeheadu.ca/students/student-life/student-services/tb/chaplaincy) is a second candidate worth checking for multi-faith programming, not yet explored.
